value.body: PR executives help organisations get their news and views into the media and manage how they are reported. They work in PR agencies and in the corporate communications teams of companies, NGOs and institutions. A day involves writing releases, calling and emailing journalists, and compiling coverage reports.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BJMC, BA, or a mass communication diploma

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Media lists, coverage trackers, social media, email

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Most freshers start as account executives or interns in a PR agency, often through internships done during the degree. A writing sample and familiarity with how newsrooms work help.

value.title: At a glance
items: Agency work means several clients at once and frequent client reviews.
Crisis communication can mean unplanned late hours.
Next steps: senior account executive, account manager, or corporate communications.
